messages:
mika (partnerships): Quick sync: AuroraKey wants to list their secrets-sync connector. Scope: SAML SSO, SCIM (PATCH + bulk), HSM-backed key-wrap, and marketplace listing + joint announcement. Can we split owners and list must-haves? :wave:

ajay (security): I can take HSM validation. Need: attestation PDF, supported wrap algorithms, wrap/unwrap API spec, TLS certs, and a read-only test key for wrap-only ops. Also need their incident contact and rotation cadence.

rachel (product): I'll own marketplace copy and install UX. Need short/long blurbs, tags (SAML, SCIM, KMS), logo assets (SVG + PNG), and one admin screenshot. Also: do they support SCIM PATCH and group sync?

aurora-ps: We support SCIM PATCH, group sync, and bulk CSV import. We'll provide screenshots and a sandbox with 3k users. Attestation and metadata available by tomorrow. Embargo: Jun 21 09:00 PT.

omar (eng): I'll own SAML and runtime integration. Need IdP metadata, sample SAML assertions, ACS URLs, and expected NameID format. I'll add toggleable CI smoke tests. Also want SCIM rate-limit behavior details.

ajnay (security): small correction: it's ajay, not ajnay. (emoji)

ajay (security): FYI: for key-wrap check ask them to run this and paste output (base64): `curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.aurorakey.com/kms/wrap -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key_id":"test-wrap","plaintext":"VGhpcy10ZXN0"}'` We will validate unwrap via their unwrap endpoint.

aurora-ps: Will run tests and send outputs. We'll also include sample unwind events (audit) and a webhook HMAC secret for verification.

rnachel (product): Timeline proposal: artifacts by Fri EOD, security call Mon, internal dry-run next Thu, announce Jun 21. Does that work?

ajay (security): Works for me. Also ask for sample unwrap audit event JSON with fields: timestamp, actor, key_id, action, request_id, result.

om ar (eng): small typo in my earlier message; should be omar :)

omar (eng): SCIM test we'll use:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{ "userName": "t.khan", "displayName": "T Khan", "emails": [{"value":"t.khan@aurora.com"}] }

nina (legal): I'll need logo + brand kit, DPA draft, and embargo/legal copy. If joint press, partner legal must approve trademark use.

ci-bot: created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integrations/pull/901 (placeholder listing + install guide stub).

mika (partnerships): Summary action items:
- Aurora -> send IdP metadata, SCIM sandbox creds, HSM attestation, DPA draft, logo + screenshots by Fri EOD.
- ajay -> schedule 30m threat-model once attestation arrives.
- omar -> add SAML + SCIM smoke tests.
- rachel -> draft marketplace blurbs and screenshot request.
- nina -> prepare legal checklist.

aurora-ps: Confirmed, we'll deliver artifacts by Fri. Thanks team.

mika (partnerships): Thanks all  I'll send calendar invites and a short agenda. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
